008package paint.ui.dialogs.project;
009
010import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
011import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
012
013/**
014 * A simplified functional DocumentListener implementation.
015 * <p>
016 * Swing's {@link DocumentListener} requires implementing three separate
017 * callbacks. This interface consolidates them into a single method
018 * {@link #update(DocumentEvent)}, making it easier to attach listeners using
019 * lambdas or method references.
020 * <p>
021 * Example usage:
022 * <pre>
023 *     textField.getDocument().addDocumentListener((SimpleDocumentListener) e -> {
024 *         System.out.println("Text changed: " + e.getDocument());
025 *     });
026 * </pre>
027 */
028@FunctionalInterface
029public interface SimpleDocumentListener extends DocumentListener {
030
031    /**
032     * Invoked when any document change occurs.
033     *
034     * @param e the document event
035     */
036    void update(DocumentEvent e);
037
038    /**
039     * Called when text is inserted into the document. Delegates to update().
040     */
041    @Override
042    default void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
043        update(e);
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Called when text is removed from the document. Delegates to update().
048     */
049    @Override
050    default void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
051        update(e);
052    }
053
054    /**
055     * Called when document attributes change. Delegates to update().
056     */
057    @Override
058    default void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) {
059        update(e);
060    }
061}
